text:
alice.sales: FYI AcmeHealth procurement needs a small evidence packet to close the PO. They specifically asked: SOC 2 excerpts, ISO scope note, pen-test attestation letter (signed), a staging network sketch, and a short note on KMS/key separation. Also they asked whether Dedicated + customer KMS changes pricing. Need a one-paragraph reply we can send to procurement.
omar.sec: We can put together a redacted SOC2 control excerpt and ISO scope statement. For pen-test we only share a one-page attestation signed by our security lead (no full reports). KMS note: we can describe logical separation and HSM usage at a high level.
tay.devops: If they want their scanner to hit staging we can create ephemeral creds and a presigned upload path. Onprem access would need ops + legal signoff. Presigned uploads expire in 7 days; naming: `acmehealth_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
sam.eng: I'll draft a redacted network diagram (no internal hostnames) and a short snippet from our encryption playbook describing tenant key separation. Need 48h to sanitize.
alice.sales: Great. Customer also asked if Dedicated + KMS is an add-on or included in the quote. Any numbers?
omar.sec: Short answer: Dedicated capacity and customer-managed KMS trigger enterprise licensing (platform fee + Dedicated commitment). There's usually an integration effort fee for KMS linkage. I'll pull the rough uplift numbers but say "subject to final quoting".
tay.devops: Operational impact: add ~3 business days for KMS integration and smoke-tests when spinning up Dedicated. If they want a formal SOW for integration, ops will need to draft it.
alice.sales: Draft reply I'll send to procurement: "We can deliver a compact evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope, signed pen-test attestation, redacted network sketch, and KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. The pen-test attestation requires legal sign-off and may take up to 7 business days for signature. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires an Enterprise plan (platform fee), Dedicated commitment (monthly/annual), and a one-time integration charge; we'll confirm exact pricing with RevOps. If you need scanning access, we can provision ephemeral staging creds and a presigned upload link with 7-day TTL." Thoughts?
omar.sec: LGTM. Add: "We do not provide raw penetration reports or access to internal logs; we can provide remediation attestations or POA for critical findings if requested."
sam.eng: I'll push the redacted diagram to the presigned bucket when ready and tag it here. ETA 48h.
tay.devops: Creating presigned path now. Will post masked creds here once ready.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf (uploader: legal-bot).
alice.sales: Thanks everyone 10g. I'll send the tentative message to procurement and mark pricing as provisional. Will loop back if they push for full report (we'll decline and offer attestation).
omar.sec: ping me if they escalate.
tay.devops: presigned link: https://presign.redwood/uploads/acmehealth_evidence/ (expires in 7d).
alice.sales: Sending now.
